sketches.mechanism: Optional chaining returns nil and silently stops evaluation when any link in the chain is nil
sketches.resonance: Reaching for someone through layers of connection, but if any link is missing, the whole attempt quietly resolves to nothing.

sketches.mechanism: The type signature 'a -> Void' means a function that can never actually return, since Void has no inhabitants
sketches.resonance: A promise to give everything of yourself is a promise that can never be fulfilled — the type system proves it impossible.

sketches.mechanism: A finally block executes regardless of whether the try block succeeds or the catch block handles the error — it runs no matter what
sketches.resonance: Some things you carry with you whether you succeed, fail, or fall apart entirely.
